summary: Frontend-only retest of NEW features (audio panel, reward boxes, marquee lights, sunburst+coin shower, mode switcher, box cost settings & persistence). All 8 acceptance bullets PASS with 0 console errors. Home shows STUDY CASINO sign with marquee chase lights above and below the EMPEZAR ESTUDIO button. Casino tab has a working mode switcher (Tragamonedas default / Cajas) — slot cabinet renders marquee lights at top and bottom; Cajas mode shows 3 wobbling box cards (bronce 15, plata 40, oro 100 default) all correctly disabled with 'INSUFICIENTE' at 0 coins. Ajustes places the 'Audio del casino' section ABOVE 'Economía y reglas' with a working toggle (green↔off color flip) and 5 volume chips that highlight in vintageRed when tapped. The 3 new box-cost settings exist (setting-bronzeBoxCost/silverBoxCost/goldBoxCost) and persist across reload — setting bronze=25 then reloading shows 25 both in Ajustes and on the Bronce box card. Slot spin at 0 coins is enabled-looking but silently no-ops (no crash). Home→Estudio→Start session→ABANDONAR shows CASINO CERRADO modal correctly. No JavaScript errors thrown anywhere during the entire flow (audio gracefully degrades on web as expected).

ui_bugs.issue: At 0 coins the lever button still renders enabled with label '¡TIRA LA PALANCA!' and only becomes 'CERRADO'/dimmed when casino is in closed state. Tapping silently no-ops via spendCoins returning false — no crash and meets the loose criteria, but UX would be clearer if the button also visually disabled when coins<spinCost.

issues: Title 'CASINO DE LA SUERTE' is truncated to 'CASINO DE LA SUE...' on a 390px wide viewport because the mode switcher takes up >40% of the top row width. Consider stacking the mode switcher below the title or shortening the SignTitle on this screen.
'AJUSTES DEL CASINO' title is truncated to 'AJUSTES DEL CASI...' on 390px wide viewport. Consider reducing SignTitle font size or shortening copy.

action_items: Optional: visually disable spin-slot-button when state.coins < state.settings.slotSpinCost (mirror the box-card 'INSUFICIENTE' pattern) — current behavior is silent no-op which is acceptable but less obvious.
Optional polish: SignTitle on Casino & Ajustes truncates on 390px — consider responsive font sizing or shorter titles.
critical_code_review_comments: casino.tsx is 977 lines — consider splitting BoxesSection, BoxOpeningModal, BoxResultModal, SlotResultModal, and Reel into their own files under /src/components/casino/ to keep files <700 lines.
Reel translateY uses (rotate.value % 60) - 30 which is fine but rotate is named misleadingly (no rotation applied); rename to spinOffset for clarity.
Acceptance criteria for box costs is met; persistence via AsyncStorage in game-store works correctly across reload.
seed_data_creation: None — app is offline AsyncStorage; default settings (15/40/100 box costs) used. One test modified bronzeBoxCost to 25 to validate persistence (still that value if you reload now).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All NEW features (audio panel, mode switcher, 3 reward box tiers, box-cost settings persistence, marquee lights on Home hero and slot cabinet, CASINO CERRADO modal after abandon) verified working with 0 console errors on web preview. testIDs verified: home-title, start-study-button, mode-slot, mode-boxes, box-bronce/plata/oro, open-bronce/plata/oro, toggle-sounds, vol-20/40/60/80/100, setting-bronzeBoxCost/silverBoxCost/goldBoxCost, spin-slot-button, start-session-button, fail-study-button (this is the ABANDONAR button — review request called it 'ABANDONAR' loosely). Audio is best-effort on web (autoplay restrictions) and degrades silently — not tested for actual sound output per instructions.
